people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”
translations.bsb: But Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, “Unless these men remain with the ship, you cannot be saved.”
translations.kjv: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
translations.asv: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
